title: ayenia vitifolia
intro: Ayenia vitifolia, commonly known as the "Guanacaste vine", is a plant species that belongs to the Malpighiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia vitifolia include its ability to exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may make it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ayenia vitifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
